 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The present application has been filed by the petitioners invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court for quashing the order dated 20.07.2022 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Patna City in Complaint Case No.1108 of 2021 by which cognizance for the offence under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 and 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 has been taken against the petitioners.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.25636 of 2024(2) dt.03-02-2026 3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner no.1 is the unmarried brother-in-law, petitioner no.2 is the mother-in-law and petitioner no.3 is the brother-in-law (Bhaisur) of the complainant/opposite party no.2 and they have no concern whatsoever with the family of the opposite party no.2 and her husband.

It has further been submitted that by a general and omnibus allegation, the petitioners have falsely been implicated and the order taking cognizance is bad in law.
